1. Connect Ethernet cable to dock, make sure no other peripherals are connected to the dock.
2. Connect Dock to DUT
3. On DUT have an Admin user with a password. If has not been created, please create one. Make sure there is a password. Preferably, make a User with OUT using an email.
a. Creating User Profile:
i. Settings -> Accounts -> Other user's
ii. Click" I don’t have this persons sign-in info"
iii. Click "Add a user without a Microsoft account"
iv. Who's Going to use this PC? : Enter name here
v. Enter Password
vi. Enter security questions (keep the answer the same, make it easy), hit Next
vii. Once created it will show up under "other users", Click the down arrow and "Change Account Type" to Admin, click ok
4. Write down, or have easy access to the NAME of your DUT (it is under About your PC)
5. On DUT: Go to Remote Desktop Settings and make sure it's turned on
6. Put your DUT to sleep using the power button, verify the screen goes black
7. On your Work device open up "Remote Desktop Connection" App
8. Computer: Write in the DUT name
9. Click on the arrow "Show Options"
10. Under "User Name" Type in the Admin User profile you created
11. Hit Connect
12. You should get a prompt asking for a Password, enter the password you created for the profile, hit enter
13. Loading screen should appear. 
a. An additional prompt may appear if this is the first time doing this asking you "The Identity of the remote computer cannot be verified. Do you want to connect anyway" Click Yes.
14. Then a window should appear and show the desktop of the DUT you remoted into, from your work machine. 
Verify: Remote Desktop granted you access.

This CTQ is based on using Magic Packet “Wake on LAN” application.  Others can be used.

1. With Surface device powered up and connected to docking station (DUT) Turn off the Wi-Fi connection of both the Surface device and the host computer (i.e. the one sending the magic packet) and turn off the firewall of the Surface device.
2. Connect Ethernet cable to docking station and the host computer.
3. Open device manager
4.  Expand “Network adapters”. Right click on the Ethernet adapter for the DUT and select properties, Select the “Advanced” tab, scroll and ensure the following settings:   Wake on Magic Packet – Value = “Enabled” Wake on Pattern Match – Value = “Enabled”
5. Select “OK” if you had to make any changes.  Otherwise, close the Device Manager windows.
6. Statically assign the IP Address, Subnet and gateway
7. On the host computer click Start Menu > Control Panel > Network and Sharing Center or Network and Internet > Network and Sharing Center.
7a. Click Change adapter settings > Right-click on Ethernet >  Click Properties > Select Internet Protocol Version 4 (TCP/IPv4) then click Properties > Select Use the following IP address.
7b. Enter the IP address (For example: 10.0.1.1), Subnet mask (For example: 255.255.255.0), Default gateway (For example: 10.0.1.2) Click OK.
8. On the DUT (surface device connected the dock), repeat steps 4.a.to 4.f. then Enter the IP address (For example: 10.0.1.2), Subnet mask (For example: 255.255.255.0), Default gateway (For example: 10.0.1.1), click okay.
9. Open Administrative Command window. Run “ipconfig /all”	Note the MAC address of the ethernet connection.
10. On the host compute, Open “Wake on LAN” application, Enter the DUT’s MAC and IP address.
11. Shutdown the surface device connected to the docking station.
12. On the host computer, select “Wake Up PC” button. Select “OK”
Verify that the DUT enters S0.

Note:  If testing multiple Surface Computers with the same docking station, the MAC and IP address will follow the docking station and not the PC it’s connected to.  So, you only need to change the MAC and IP address when changing docking stations.

8. On the DUT (surface device connected the dock), repeat steps 4.a.to 4.f. then Enter the IP address (For example: 10.0.1.2), Subnet mask (For example: 255.255.255.0), Default gateway (For example: 10.0.1.1), click okay.
9. Open Administrative Command window. Run “ipconfig /all”	Note the MAC address of the ethernet connection.
10. On the host compute, Open “Wake on LAN” application, Enter the DUT’s MAC and IP address.
11. Hibernate the surface device connected to the docking station.
12. On the host computer, select “Wake Up PC” button. Select “OK”
Verify that the DUT enters S0.

Note:  If testing multiple Surface Computers with the same docking station, the MAC and IP address will follow the docking station and not the PC it’s connected to.  So, you only need to change the MAC and IP address when changing docking stations.
